detail: Removed a non-official figure-based transcription and restored the official jump rule: common vertex but no common side.
Corrected malformed transcription: intersection point is H (not O); a and b intersect at X; c and d intersect at Y.
Corrected transcription bars to the official floor expression floor(sqrt(3) d(n)).
Corrected the exponent to the official tower 2^(2^(2^2023)), not a product 2*2023 in the exponent.
Removed AI-MO images that are not figures in the official final statement (solution/header/document images or spurious attachments).
Added logical figure references for figures present in the official problem sheet but absent from AI-MO statement metadata.
